paraphrase: Praising the Mahāyāna zazen, which includes all the perfections, recitation and repentance: if one turns inward and bears witness to one's own nature, which is no-nature, the gate of the oneness of cause and effect opens; this very place is the Lotus Land, this very body is the Buddha.
speaker: Hakuin
notes: From memory; the text is not held locally, so no original is quoted and section labels are descriptive.

paraphrase: All sentient beings are originally buddhas; as with water and ice, there is no ice apart from water and no buddhas apart from beings; not knowing it is near, beings seek it far away, like one in water crying from thirst.
speaker: Hakuin
